summary: Detects and highlights image edges by comparing neighboring pixels, with channel selection and compositing controls.

key_params.name: select
key_params.note: Edge source: luminance, RGBA channels, RGB average, or RGBA average

key_params.name: blacklevel
key_params.note: Black level applied before finding edges

key_params.name: alphaoutputmenu
key_params.note: Alpha output mode: edge, one, or zero

key_params.name: combineinput
key_params.note: Output edge only or composite edge with input

key_params.name: operand
key_params.note: Composite operation when combining with input

common_gotchas: High Strength can turn image noise into apparent edges.
Alpha can be edge, one, or zero; it does not automatically preserve input alpha.
Combine with Input, Operand, and Swap Order all affect final blend math.
key_concepts: Edge TOP finds edges by comparing each pixel to neighboring pixels.
Select chooses the source channel or channel average used for edge detection.
Black Level preprocesses the image before edge extraction.
Strength increases detected edge gain and detail visibility.
Offset and Offset Unit control the sample distance used to detect edges.
Edge output can be edge-only or composited back with the input using blend operations.
